selection_rationale: A single cohesive kinetic battle line: one 262mm-nose battleship anchors point defense (3 turrets) while three battlecruisers and two destroyers add six spinal coilers and heavy batteries for a 35.7 GJ close-range alpha. All hulls run 1.0-2.0g so the line closes together and forces the <300 km envelope where coilgun accuracy and mutual-closure energy peak, while 13 PD turrets thin any torpedo salvo before it commits.
formation_rationale: Sovereign (toughest hull) pushed to +x as the vanguard to eat the first exchange. Falchions screen ahead-left/ahead-right of her, ~55-65 km off-axis so their point-defense envelopes overlap the battleship and each other. The three Lancers form a second gunline 50 km back and spread laterally (±70 km), still inside the ~100 km PD net, giving me a wide overlapping defensive umbrella while presenting three separated spinal threats. Modest z-staggering breaks a flat plane without opening PD gaps.
